models_evaluated: 3D residual network ensemble model with clinical risk factors

links.outcome: AI diagnostic performance compared with senior radiologists and FNA reference in prospectively enrolled lymph nodes
links.effect: Ensemble model AUC 0.829, sensitivity 0.839, specificity 0.769, accuracy 82.3%; not significantly different from FNA (P=0.115) or the two senior radiologists (P=1.000, P=0.392).
links.quote: With FNA results as the criterion standard, the ensemble model had excellent diagnostic performance ( P =0.115), similar to that of the two senior radiologists ( P =1.000 and P =0.392, respectively).

screen.reason: Prospective diagnostic accuracy validation of an ensemble deep learning model on CT images compared against senior radiologists and FNA; tests diagnostic accuracy without evaluating a deployment practice or organizational safeguard.
